nodes.name: claude-code-deep-dive.md
nodes.summary: Deep architectural analysis of Claude Code's agent orchestration, memory system, query engine, tool harness, skills framework, and task system — extracts patterns and produces a prioritized implementation blueprint for adopting into Waggle OS.
nodes.languageNotes: 40-section document covering agent orchestration, multi-layer compaction, subagent fork patterns, memory four-type taxonomy, and tool permission systems — the most detailed technical reference in the waggle-cowork folder.

nodes.name: claude-code-source-analysis.md
nodes.summary: Strategic analysis of Claude Code's source repository contrasting it against Waggle OS across agent systems, memory, tool harness, and query engine — provides verdicts on open-multi-agent and claw-code repositories and corrects an earlier memory assessment.

nodes.name: system-prompt-comparison.md
nodes.summary: Head-to-head comparison of Waggle OS and Claude Code system prompt architectures covering persona definitions, behavioral specs, and prompt assembly — identifies specific improvements for Waggle grouped by priority (P0–P3) including prompt caching, behavioral spec restructuring, and compaction prompts.

nodes.name: waggle-os-improvement-plan.md
nodes.summary: Consolidated improvement plan for Waggle OS organized into six workstreams (agent orchestration, memory optimization, context/token management, tool harness, skills framework, task system) with a ranked priority matrix and execution sequence derived from Claude Code architectural patterns.

nodes.name: waggle-prompt-improvement-plan.md
nodes.summary: Detailed implementation plan for Waggle OS system prompt and persona improvements covering four new agent personas (general-purpose, planner, verifier, coordinator), existing persona hardening with safety blocks and failure patterns, behavioral spec refactoring, and a phased 6-week execution schedule.
